name: Tafl custody
description: Black has rolled 5 (leader) and 3 (heavy). Black's Tafl King on d1, moving up to d5, holds three enemies at once against Black pieces beyond them: c5 (Rook on b5), e5 (Bishop on f5) and d6 (Rook on d7). Black's Swede on h3, moving to f3, holds f4 (Bishop on f5) and f2 (Pawn on f1). A piece that moves between two of Black's is not taken.
